title: Database connection timeout on prod-db-01
description: Production database prod-db-01 is experiencing repeated connection timeouts. All services relying on it are down. Immediate attention required.

title: Suspicious login attempts from unknown IP
description: Multiple failed login attempts detected from IP 203.0.113.42. Possible brute-force attack targeting admin accounts.

title: Checkout service returning NullPointerException
description: The checkout microservice is throwing NullPointerException on every order submission. Stack trace indicates a null cart reference in CartService.java:142.

title: Network switch offline in DC rack B
description: The Cisco switch in Data Centre rack B is offline. All servers connected via VLAN 20 are unreachable. Production environment impacted.

title: Ransomware signature detected on workstation
description: AV scanner detected a ransomware signature (WannaCry variant) on workstation WIN-FINANCE-04. Machine isolated from network. Breach may have occurred.

title: Payment gateway timeout — Stripe API 503
description: The Stripe payment gateway integration is returning HTTP-503 Service Unavailable. All payment transactions are failing. Revenue impacted.

title: Intermittent packet loss on VLAN 30
description: Monitoring shows 15% intermittent packet loss on VLAN 30 between switches SW-CORE-01 and SW-DIST-03. Affecting file transfer services.

title: Phishing email reported by 3 employees
description: Three employees have forwarded a phishing email impersonating the IT helpdesk requesting password resets. Links redirect to a spoofed login page.

title: API response slow — P95 latency 4.2s
description: The product catalogue API is degraded. P95 latency has risen to 4.2 seconds — well above the 500ms SLA. Root cause unknown, investigation ongoing.

title: Scheduled job failed — non-production env
description: The nightly ETL job failed in the staging environment due to a missing configuration variable. No production impact. Low priority fix required.

title: Minor firewall rule misconfiguration found
description: A routine audit identified a firewall rule that permits traffic on an unused port 8088. Risk is low but the rule should be removed for compliance.

title: DNS resolution intermittent on 10.2.0.0/16
description: DNS queries from the 10.2.0.0/16 subnet are failing intermittently. Affecting ~30 hosts. Issue is slow and degraded rather than a full outage.
